statements.subject: server
statements.description: An EXPUNGE response MUST NOT be sent when no command is in progress

statements.subject: server
statements.description: An EXPUNGE response MUST NOT be sent while responding to a FETCH, STORE, or SEARCH command
statements.pre_cond: server.active_command = FETCH | server.active_command = STORE | server.active_command = SEARCH

statements.subject: server
statements.description: An EXPUNGE response MAY be sent during a UID command (UID FETCH, UID STORE, UID SEARCH are different commands from FETCH, STORE, SEARCH)
statements.pre_cond: server.active_command = UID_FETCH | server.active_command = UID_STORE | server.active_command = UID_SEARCH

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A command is not 'in progress' until the complete command has been received; in particular, a command is not 'in progress' during the negotiation of command continuation
statements.guard_semantics: server.command_in_progress = true only after complete command received and not during continuation negotiation

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The update from the EXPUNGE response MUST be remembered by the client
actions: decrement message sequence numbers for all successive messages
